INSERT INTO NOTICE ( NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, IMPORTANT, STATUS, CREATED_ID, CREATED_DT, UPDATED_ID ) VALUES ( #{noticeId}, #{title}, #{content}, NVL(#{important}, 'N'), NVL(#{status}, 'DRAFT'), #{createdId}, SYSDATE, #{updatedId} )
mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, IMPORTANT, STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, UPDATED_ID, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}

SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, IMPORTANT, VIEW_COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM ( SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, IMPORTANT, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY IMPORTANT DESC, NOTICE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' ) WHERE RN BETWEEN (#{offset} + 1) AND (#{offset} + #{pageSize}) ORDER BY RN
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, IMPORTANT, VIEW_COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, IMPORTANT = #{important}, STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_ID = #{updatedId}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
